in_text_mentions: In H&E sections, all cases demonstrated thickened or completely hyalinized collagen bundles with atrophic epithelium, decreased cellularity (fibroblasts), compressed blood vessels and degeneration of muscle fibres. In early OSMF cases, 33% (8 out of 24 cases) showed no adipose tissue while advanced cases 86.7% (52 out of 60 cases) showed lack of adipose tissue. These findings were found to be statistically significant with Chi-square analysis with p value being <0.01 ( Table 1, Fig. 1).
